literal: One birth deed performs fool, all seven births himself having entered will sink hell.
translation: In a single birth, a fool performs deeds that will plunge him into hell, where he will sink and suffer for seven births.
modern: ஒரு பிறவியில் செய்யும் தீய செயல்களால், அறிவற்றவன் தொடர்ந்து வரும் ஏழு பிறவிகளிலும் நரகத்தில் புகுந்து துன்பத்தில் அழுந்துவான்.
explanation: The couplet contrasts the brevity of a fool's actions with the lasting consequences they bring. 'ஒருமை' (one birth) and 'எழுமை' (seven births) are juxtaposed to show how a single lifetime of foolish deeds leads to prolonged suffering. The word 'அளறு' refers to hell or a deep mire, illustrating the inescapable misery the fool creates for himself. By acting without foresight, the fool ensures his own downfall across multiple lifetimes.
